product_metadata.title: Microwave Spatter Screen, Red Beads
features: Save time! Revolutionary flexible 13" mesh eliminates spatters and keeps microwave clean.
Stain resistant, durable, easy to use and clean. Just Rinse!
Weighted to stay in place to fit most plates and bowl sizes!
Save $! Eliminates Paper and plastic wrap waste.
For better cooking and reheating. BPA Free FDA Food Contact Safe material. MADE IN THE USA!
description: End hard to clean microwave messes. Save $ and the environment! Now you can stop using and throwing away saran wrap and paper towels. The Microwave Spatter Screen is an ingenious, affordable, ENVIRONMENTALLY SAFE and EASY TO USE, SPACE AGE CLOTH (made of a proprietary polyester blend) that FITS OVER MOST FOOD CONTAINERS WHILE MICROWAVE COOKING TO KEEP MICROWAVE CLEAN AND SPATTER FREE. The screen is reusable and durable, comes with a lifetime guarantee, replacing paper and saran wrap waste! Unlike ordinary plastic, expensive, covers, which are restricted in application by shape and size, the MICROWAVE SPATTER SCREEN conforms to almost every shape and size container and can be easily stored in any drawer. And its proprietary mesh material and beads literally rinses clean (and can be laundered) and does not stain. Plus users report that the breathable mesh design allows the food to steam for faster cooking and crispier fresher tasting food without the mushy texture you get from plastic lids or saran wraps. Great for home, college kids, and office too! Assembled by and supporting opportunities for handicapped adults with disabilities.
